text_en: The burden that Habacuc the prophet saw.
text_la: Onus quod vidit Habacuc propheta.
text_pt: O peso que viu o profeta Habacuque.
text_el: τὸ λῆμμα ὃ εἶδεν Αμβακουμ ὁ προφήτης

text_en: How long, O Lord , shall I cry, and you will not hear? Shall I cry out to you suffering violence , and you will not save?
text_la: Usquequo, Domine, clamabo, et non exaudies? vociferabor ad te, vim patiens, et non salvabis?
text_pt: Até quando, Senhor, clamarei eu, e tu não me escutarás? Gritar-te-ei: Violência! e não salvarás?
text_el: ἕως τίνος κύριε κεκράξομαι καὶ οὐ μὴ εἰσακούσῃς βοήσομαι πρὸς σὲ ἀδικούμενος καὶ οὐ σώσεις

text_en: Why have you shown me iniquity and grievance, to see rapine and injustice before me? And there is a judgment , but opposition is more powerful.
text_la: Quare ostendisti mihi iniquitatem et laborem, videre prædam et injustitiam contra me? Et factum est judicium, et contradictio potentior.
text_pt: Por que razão me mostras a iniqüidade, e me fazes ver a opressão? Pois que a destruição e a violência estão diante de mim, havendo também quem suscite a contenda e o litígio.
text_el: ἵνα τί μοι ἔδειξας κόπους καὶ πόνους ἐπιβλέπειν ταλαιπωρίαν καὶ ἀσέβειαν ἐξ ἐναντίας μου γέγονεν κρίσις καὶ ὁ κριτὴς λαμβάνει

text_en: Therefore the law is torn in pieces, and judgment comes not to the end: because the wicked prevails against the just , therefore wrong judgment goes forth.
text_la: Propter hoc lacerata est lex, et non pervenit usque ad finem judicium; quia impius prævalet adversus justum, propterea egreditur judicium perversum.
text_pt: Por esta causa a lei se afrouxa, e a justiça nunca se manifesta; porque o ímpio cerca o justo, e a justiça se manifesta distorcida.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο διεσκέδασται νόμος καὶ οὐ διεξάγεται εἰς τέλος κρίμα ὅτι ὁ ἀσεβὴς καταδυναστεύει τὸν δίκαιον ἕνεκεν τούτου ἐξελεύσεται τὸ κρίμα διεστραμμένον

text_en: Behold you among the nations , and see: wonder, and be astonished: for a work is done in your days, which no man will believe when it shall be told.
text_la: Aspicite in gentibus, et videte; admiramini, et obstupescite : quia opus factum est in diebus vestris, quod nemo credet cum narrabitur.
text_pt: Vede entre os gentios e olhai, e maravilhai-vos, e admirai-vos; porque realizarei em vossos dias uma obra que vós não crereis, quando for contada.
text_el: ἴδετε οἱ καταφρονηταί καὶ ἐπιβλέψατε καὶ θαυμάσατε θαυμάσια καὶ ἀφανίσθητε διότι ἔργον ἐγὼ ἐργάζομαι ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ὑμῶν ὃ οὐ μὴ πιστεύσητε ἐάν τις ἐκδιηγῆται

text_en: For behold, I will raise up the Chaldeans , a bitter and swift nation, marching upon the breadth of the earth, to possess the dwelling places that are not their own.
text_la: Quia ecce ego suscitabo Chaldæos, gentem amaram et velocem, ambulantem super latitudinem terræ, ut possideat tabernacula non sua.
text_pt: Porque eis que suscito os caldeus, nação amarga e impetuosa, que marcha sobre a largura da terra, para apoderar-se de moradas que não são suas.
text_el: διότι ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐξεγείρω ἐφ' ὑμᾶς τοὺς Χαλδαίους τοὺς μαχητάς τὸ ἔθνος τὸ πικρὸν καὶ τὸ ταχινὸν τὸ πορευόμενον ἐπὶ τὰ πλάτη τῆς γῆς τοῦ κατακληρονομῆσαι σκηνώματα οὐκ αὐτοῦ

text_en: They are dreadful, and terrible: from themselves shall their judgment, and their burden proceed.
text_la: Horribilis et terribilis est : ex semetipsa judicium et onus ejus egredietur.
text_pt: Horrível e terrível é; dela mesma sairá o seu juízo e a sua dignidade.
text_el: φοβερὸς καὶ ἐπιφανής ἐστιν ἐξ αὐτοῦ τὸ κρίμα αὐτοῦ ἔσται καὶ τὸ λῆμμα αὐτοῦ ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἐξελεύσεται

text_en: Their horses are lighter than leopards, and swifter than evening wolves; and their horsemen shall be spread abroad: for their horsemen shall come from afar, they shall fly as an eagle that makes haste to eat.
text_la: Leviores pardis equi ejus, et velociores lupis vespertinis : et diffundentur equites ejus : equites namque ejus de longe venient; volabunt quasi aquila festinans ad comedendum.
text_pt: E os seus cavalos são mais ligeiros do que os leopardos, e mais espertos do que os lobos à tarde; os seus cavaleiros espalham-se por toda parte; os seus cavaleiros virão de longe; voarão como águias que se apressam a devorar.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαλοῦνται ὑπὲρ παρδάλεις οἱ ἵπποι αὐτοῦ καὶ ὀξύτεροι ὑπὲρ τοὺς λύκους τῆς Ἀραβίας καὶ ἐξιππάσονται οἱ ἱππεῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ ὁρμήσουσιν μακρόθεν καὶ πετασθήσονται ὡς ἀετὸς πρόθυμος εἰς τὸ φαγεῖν

text_en: They shall all come to the prey, their face is like a burning wind: and they shall gather together captives as the sand.
text_la: Omnes ad prædam venient, facies eorum ventus urens; et congregabit quasi arenam captivitatem.
text_pt: Eles todos virão para fazer violência; os seus rostos buscarão o vento oriental, e reunirão os cativos como areia.
text_el: συντέλεια εἰς ἀσεβεῖς ἥξει ἀνθεστηκότας προσώποις αὐτῶν ἐξ ἐναντίας καὶ συνάξει ὡς ἄμμον αἰχμαλωσίαν

text_en: And their prince shall triumph over kings, and princes shall be his laughingstock: and he shall laugh at every strong hold, and shall cast up a mount, and shall take it.
text_la: Et ipse de regibus triumphabit, et tyranni ridiculi ejus erunt; ipse super omnem munitionem ridebit, et comportabit aggerem, et capiet eam.
text_pt: E escarnecerão dos reis, e dos príncipes farão zombaria; eles se rirão de todas as fortalezas, porque amontoarão terra, e as tomarão.
text_el: καὶ αὐτὸς ἐν βασιλεῦσιν ἐντρυφήσει καὶ τύραννοι παίγνια αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐτὸς εἰς πᾶν ὀχύρωμα ἐμπαίξεται καὶ βαλεῖ χῶμα καὶ κρατήσει αὐτοῦ

text_en: Then shall his spirit be changed, and he shall pass, and fall: this is his strength of his god.
text_la: Tunc mutabitur spiritus, et pertransibit, et corruet : hæc est fortitudo ejus dei sui.
text_pt: Então muda a sua mente, e seguirá, e se fará culpado, atribuindo este seu poder ao seu deus.
text_el: τότε μεταβαλεῖ τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ διελεύσεται καὶ ἐξιλάσεται αὕτη ἡ ἰσχὺς τῷ θεῷ μου

text_en: Were you not from the beginning, O Lord my God , my holy one, and we shall not die? Lord , you have appointed him for judgment : and made him strong for correction.
text_la: Numquid non tu a principio, Domine, Deus meus, sancte meus, et non moriemur? Domine, in judicium posuisti eum, et fortem, ut corriperes, fundasti eum.
text_pt: Não és tu desde a eternidade, ó Senhor meu Deus, meu Santo? Nós não morreremos. Ó Senhor, para juízo o puseste, e tu, ó Rocha, o fundaste para castigar.
text_el: οὐχὶ σὺ ἀπ' ἀρχῆς κύριε ὁ θεὸς ὁ ἅγιός μου καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀποθάνωμεν κύριε εἰς κρίμα τέταχας αὐτόν καὶ ἔπλασέν με τοῦ ἐλέγχειν παιδείαν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Your eyes are too pure to behold evil , and you can not look on iniquity . Why do you look upon them that do unjust things, and hold your peace when the wicked devours the man that is more just than himself?
text_la: Mundi sunt oculi tui, ne videas malum, et respicere ad iniquitatem non poteris. Quare respicis super iniqua agentes, et taces devorante impio justiorem se?
text_pt: Tu és tão puro de olhos, que não podes ver o mal, e a opressão não podes contemplar. Por que olhas para os que procedem aleivosamente, e te calas quando o ímpio devora aquele que é mais justo do que ele?
text_el: καθαρὸς ὀφθαλμὸς τοῦ μὴ ὁρᾶν πονηρά καὶ ἐπιβλέπειν ἐπὶ πόνους οὐ δυνήσῃ ἵνα τί ἐπιβλέπεις ἐπὶ καταφρονοῦντας παρασιωπήσῃ ἐν τῷ καταπίνειν ἀσεβῆ τὸν δίκαιον

text_en: And you will make men as the fishes of the sea, and as the creeping things that have no ruler.
text_la: Et facies homines quasi pisces maris, et quasi reptile non habens principem.
text_pt: E por que farias os homens como os peixes do mar, como os répteis, que não têm quem os governe?
text_el: καὶ ποιήσεις τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ὡς τοὺς ἰχθύας τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ ὡς τὰ ἑρπετὰ τὰ οὐκ ἔχοντα ἡγούμενον

text_en: He lifted up all them with his hook, he drew them in his drag, and gathered them into his net: for this he will be glad and rejoice.
text_la: Totum in hamo sublevavit, traxit illud in sagena sua, et congregavit in rete suum. Super hoc lætabitur, et exsultabit.
text_pt: Ele a todos levantará com o anzol, apanhá-los-á com a sua rede, e os ajuntará na sua rede varredoura; por isso ele se alegrará e se regozijará.
text_el: συντέλειαν ἐν ἀγκίστρῳ ἀνέσπασεν καὶ εἵλκυσεν αὐτὸν ἐν ἀμφιβλήστρῳ καὶ συνήγαγεν αὐτὸν ἐν ταῖς σαγήναις αὐτοῦ ἕνεκεν τούτου εὐφρανθήσεται καὶ χαρήσεται ἡ καρδία αὐτοῦ

text_en: Therefore will he offer victims to his drag, and he will sacrifice to his net: because through them his portion is made fat, and his meat dainty.
text_la: Propterea immolabit sagenæ suæ, et sacrificabit reti suo, quia in ipsis incrassata est pars ejus, et cibus ejus electus.
text_pt: Por isso sacrificará à sua rede, e queimará incenso à sua varredoura; porque com elas engordou a sua porção, e engrossou a sua comida.
text_el: ἕνεκεν τούτου θύσει τῇ σαγήνῃ αὐτοῦ καὶ θυμιάσει τῷ ἀμφιβλήστρῳ αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐλίπανεν μερίδα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ βρώματα αὐτοῦ ἐκλεκτά

text_en: For this cause therefore he spreads his net, and will not spare continually to slay the nations .
text_la: Propter hoc ergo expandit sagenam suam, et semper interficere gentes non parcet.
text_pt: Porventura por isso esvaziará a sua rede e não terá piedade de matar as nações continuamente?
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἀμφιβαλεῖ τὸ ἀμφίβληστρον αὐτοῦ καὶ διὰ παντὸς ἀποκτέννειν ἔθνη οὐ φείσεται

text_en: I will stand upon my watch, and fix my foot upon the tower: and I will watch, to see what will be said to me, and what I may answer to him that reproves me.
text_la: Super custodiam meam stabo, et figam gradum super munitionem : et contemplabor ut videam quid dicatur mihi, et quid respondeam ad arguentem me.
text_pt: Sobre a minha guarda estarei, e sobre a fortaleza me apresentarei e vigiarei, para ver o que falará a mim, e o que eu responderei quando eu for argüido.
text_el: ἐπὶ τῆς φυλακῆς μου στήσομαι καὶ ἐπιβήσομαι ἐπὶ πέτραν καὶ ἀποσκοπεύσω τοῦ ἰδεῖν τί λαλήσει ἐν ἐμοὶ καὶ τί ἀποκριθῶ ἐπὶ τὸν ἔλεγχόν μου

text_en: And the Lord answered me, and said: Write the vision , and make it plain upon tables: that he that reads it may run over it.
text_la: Et respondit mihi Dominus, et dixit : Scribe visum, et explana eum super tabulas, ut percurrat qui legerit eum.
text_pt: Então o Senhor me respondeu, e disse: Escreve a visão e torna-a bem legível sobre tábuas, para que a possa ler quem passa correndo.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη πρός με κύριος καὶ εἶπεν γράψον ὅρασιν καὶ σαφῶς ἐπὶ πυξίον ὅπως διώκῃ ὁ ἀναγινώσκων αὐτά

text_en: For as yet the vision is far off, and it shall appear at the end, and shall not lie : if it make any delay, wait for it: for it shall surely come, and it shall not be slack.
text_la: Quia adhuc visus procul; et apparebit in finem, et non mentietur : si moram fecerit, exspecta illum, quia veniens veniet, et non tardabit.
text_pt: Porque a visão é ainda para o tempo determinado, mas se apressa para o fim, e não enganará; se tardar, espera-o, porque certamente virá, não tardará.
text_el: διότι ἔτι ὅρασις εἰς καιρὸν καὶ ἀνατελεῖ εἰς πέρας καὶ οὐκ εἰς κενόν ἐὰν ὑστερήσῃ ὑπόμεινον αὐτόν ὅτι ἐρχόμενος ἥξει καὶ οὐ μὴ χρονίσῃ

text_en: Behold, he that is unbelieving, his soul shall not be right in himself: but the just shall live in his faith .
text_la: Ecce qui incredulus est, non erit recta anima ejus in semetipso; justus autem in fide sua vivet.
text_pt: Eis que a sua alma está orgulhosa, não é reta nele; mas o justo pela sua fé viverá.
text_el: ἐὰν ὑποστείληται οὐκ εὐδοκεῖ ἡ ψυχή μου ἐν αὐτῷ ὁ δὲ δίκαιος ἐκ πίστεώς μου ζήσεται

text_en: And as wine deceives him that drinks it: so shall the proud man be, and he shall not be honoured : who has enlarged his desire like hell: and is himself like death, and he is never satisfied: but will gather together unto him all nations , and heap together unto him all people.
text_la: Et quomodo vinum potantem decipit, sic erit vir superbus, et non decorabitur : qui dilatavit quasi infernus animam suam, et ipse quasi mors, et non adimpletur : et congregabit ad se omnes gentes, et coacervabit ad se omnes populos.
text_pt: Tanto mais que, por ser dado ao vinho é desleal; homem soberbo que não permanecerá; que alarga como o inferno a sua alma; e é como a morte que não se farta, e ajunta a si todas as nações, e congrega a si todos os povos.
text_el: ὁ δὲ κατοινωμένος καὶ καταφρονητὴς ἀνὴρ ἀλαζών οὐδὲν μὴ περάνῃ ὃς ἐπλάτυνεν καθὼς ὁ ᾅδης τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ οὗτος ὡς θάνατος οὐκ ἐμπιπλάμενος καὶ ἐπισυνάξει ἐπ' αὐτὸν πάντα τὰ ἔθνη καὶ εἰσδέξεται πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντας τοὺς λαούς

text_en: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a dark speech concerning him: and it shall be said: Woe to him that heaps together that which is not his own? How long also does he load himself with thick clay?
text_la: Numquid non omnes isti super eum parabolam sument, et loquelam ænigmatum ejus, et dicetur : Væ ei qui multiplicat non sua? usquequo et aggravat contra se densum lutum?
text_pt: Não levantarão, pois, todos estes contra ele uma parábola e um provérbio sarcástico contra ele? E se dirá: Ai daquele que multiplica o que não é seu! (até quando? ) e daquele que carrega sobre si dívidas!
text_el: οὐχὶ ταῦτα πάντα παραβολὴν κατ' αὐτοῦ λήμψονται καὶ πρόβλημα εἰς διήγησιν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐροῦσιν οὐαὶ ὁ πληθύνων ἑαυτῷ τὰ οὐκ ὄντα αὐτοῦ ἕως τίνος καὶ βαρύνων τὸν κλοιὸν αὐτοῦ στιβαρῶς

text_en: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite you: and they be stirred up that shall tear you, and you shall be a spoil to them?
text_la: Numquid non repente consurgent qui mordeant te, et suscitabuntur lacerantes te, et eris in rapinam eis?
text_pt: Porventura não se levantarão de repente os teus extorquiadores, e não despertarão os que te farão tremer, e não lhes servirás tu de despojo?
text_el: ὅτι ἐξαίφνης ἀναστήσονται δάκνοντες αὐτόν καὶ ἐκνήψουσιν οἱ ἐπίβουλοί σου καὶ ἔσῃ εἰς διαρπαγὴν αὐτοῖς

text_en: Because you have spoiled many nations , all that shall be left of the people shall spoil you: because of men's blood, and for the iniquity of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
text_la: Quia tu spoliasti gentes multas, spoliabunt te omnes qui reliqui fuerint de populis, propter sanguinem hominis, et iniquitatem terræ, civitatis, et omnium habitantium in ea.
text_pt: Porquanto despojaste a muitas nações, todos os demais povos te despojarão a ti, por causa do sangue dos homens, e da violência feita à terra, à cidade, e a todos os que nela habitam.
text_el: διότι σὺ ἐσκύλευσας ἔθνη πολλά σκυλεύσουσίν σε πάντες οἱ ὑπολελειμμένοι λαοὶ δι' αἵματα ἀνθρώπων καὶ ἀσεβείας γῆς καὶ πόλεως καὶ πάντων τῶν κατοικούντων αὐτήν

text_en: Woe to him that gathers together an evil covetousness to his house, that his nest may be on high, and thinks he may be delivered out of the hand of evil .
text_la: Væ qui congregat avaritiam malam domui suæ, ut sit in excelso nidus ejus, et liberari se putat de manu mali!
text_pt: Ai daquele que, para a sua casa, ajunta cobiçosamente bens mal adquiridos, para pôr o seu ninho no alto, a fim de se livrar do poder do mal!
text_el: ὦ ὁ πλεονεκτῶν πλεονεξίαν κακὴν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ τοῦ τάξαι εἰς ὕψος νοσσιὰν αὐτοῦ τοῦ ἐκσπασθῆναι ἐκ χειρὸς κακῶν

text_en: You have devised confusion to your house, you have cut off many people, and your soul has sinned .
text_la: Cogitasti confusionem domui tuæ; concidisti populos multos, et peccavit anima tua.
text_pt: Vergonha maquinaste para a tua casa; destruindo tu a muitos povos, pecaste contra a tua alma.
text_el: ἐβουλεύσω αἰσχύνην τῷ οἴκῳ σου συνεπέρανας λαοὺς πολλούς καὶ ἐξήμαρτεν ἡ ψυχή σου

text_en: For the stone shall cry out of the wall: and the timber that is between the joints of the building, shall answer.
text_la: Quia lapis de pariete clamabit, et lignum, quod inter juncturas ædificiorum est, respondebit.
text_pt: Porque a pedra clamará da parede, e a trave lhe responderá do madeiramento.
text_el: διότι λίθος ἐκ τοίχου βοήσεται καὶ κάνθαρος ἐκ ξύλου φθέγξεται αὐτά

text_en: Woe to him that builds a town with blood, and prepares a city by iniquity .
text_la: Væ qui ædificat civitatem in sanguinibus, et præparat urbem in iniquitate!
text_pt: Ai daquele que edifica a cidade com sangue, e que funda a cidade com iniqüidade!
text_el: οὐαὶ ὁ οἰκοδομῶν πόλιν ἐν αἵμασιν καὶ ἑτοιμάζων πόλιν ἐν ἀδικίαις

text_en: Are not these things from the Lord of hosts ? For the people shall labour in a great fire: and the nations in vain, and they shall faint.
text_la: Numquid non hæc sunt a Domino exercituum? laborabunt enim populi in multo igne, et gentes in vacuum, et deficient.
text_pt: Porventura não vem do Senhor dos Exércitos que os povos trabalhem pelo fogo e os homens se cansem em vão?
text_el: οὐ ταῦτά ἐστιν παρὰ κυρίου παντοκράτορος καὶ ἐξέλιπον λαοὶ ἱκανοὶ ἐν πυρί καὶ ἔθνη πολλὰ ὠλιγοψύχησαν

text_en: For the earth shall be filled, that men may know the glory of the Lord , as waters covering the sea.
text_la: Quia replebitur terra, ut cognoscant gloriam Domini, quasi aquæ operientes mare.
text_pt: Porque a terra se encherá do conhecimento da glória do Senhor, como as águas cobrem o mar.
text_el: ὅτι πλησθήσεται ἡ γῆ τοῦ γνῶναι τὴν δόξαν κυρίου ὡς ὕδωρ κατακαλύψει αὐτούς

text_en: Woe to him that gives drink to his friend, and presents his gall, and makes him drunk , that he may behold his nakedness.
text_la: Væ qui potum dat amico suo mittens fel suum, et inebrians ut aspiciat nuditatem ejus!
text_pt: Ai daquele que dá de beber ao seu companheiro! Ai de ti, que adicionas à bebida o teu furor, e o embebedas para ver a sua nudez!
text_el: ὦ ὁ ποτίζων τὸν πλησίον αὐτοῦ ἀνατροπῇ θολερᾷ καὶ μεθύσκων ὅπως ἐπιβλέπῃ ἐπὶ τὰ σπήλαια αὐτῶν

text_en: You are filled with shame instead of glory : drink also, and fall fast asleep: the cup of the right hand of the Lord shall compass you, and shameful vomiting shall be on your glory .
text_la: Repletus es ignominia pro gloria; bibe tu quoque, et consopire. Circumdabit te calix dexteræ Domini, et vomitus ignominiæ super gloriam tuam.
text_pt: Serás farto de ignomínia em lugar de honra; bebe tu também, e sê como um incircunciso; o cálice da mão direita do Senhor voltará a ti, e ignomínia cairá sobre a tua glória.
text_el: πλησμονὴν ἀτιμίας ἐκ δόξης πίε καὶ σὺ καὶ διασαλεύθητι καὶ σείσθητι ἐκύκλωσεν ἐπὶ σὲ ποτήριον δεξιᾶς κυρίου καὶ συνήχθη ἀτιμία ἐπὶ τὴν δόξαν σου

text_en: For the iniquity of Libanus shall cover you, and the ravaging of beasts shall terrify them because of the blood of men , and the iniquity of the land, and of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
text_la: Quia iniquitas Libani operiet te, et vastitas animalium deterrebit eos de sanguinibus hominum, et iniquitate terræ, et civitatis, et omnium habitantium in ea.
text_pt: Porque a violência cometida contra o Líbano te cobrirá, e a destruição das feras te amedrontará, por causa do sangue dos homens, e da violência feita à terra, à cidade, e a todos os que nela habitam.
text_el: διότι ἀσέβεια τοῦ Λιβάνου καλύψει σε καὶ ταλαιπωρία θηρίων πτοήσει σε διὰ αἵματα ἀνθρώπων καὶ ἀσεβείας γῆς καὶ πόλεως καὶ πάντων τῶν κατοικούντων αὐτήν

text_en: What does the graven thing avail, because the maker thereof has graven it, a molten, and a false image? Because the forger thereof has trusted in a thing of his own forging, to make dumb idols .
text_la: Quid prodest sculptile, quia sculpsit illud fictor suus, conflatile, et imaginem falsam? quia speravit in figmento fictor ejus, ut faceret simulacra muta.
text_pt: Que aproveita a imagem de escultura, depois que a esculpiu o seu artífice? Ela é imagem de fundição que ensina mentira, para que quem a formou confie na sua obra, fazendo ídolos mudos?
text_el: τί ὠφελεῖ γλυπτόν ὅτι ἔγλυψαν αὐτό ἔπλασαν αὐτὸ χώνευμα φαντασίαν ψευδῆ ὅτι πέποιθεν ὁ πλάσας ἐπὶ τὸ πλάσμα αὐτοῦ τοῦ ποιῆσαι εἴδωλα κωφά

text_en: Woe to him that says to wood: Awake: to the dumb stone: Arise: can it teach? Behold, it is laid over with gold, and silver, and there is no spirit in the bowels thereof.
text_la: Væ qui dicit ligno : Expergiscere; Surge, lapidi tacenti! Numquid ipse docere poterit? ecce iste coopertus est auro et argento, et omnis spiritus non est in visceribus ejus.
text_pt: Ai daquele que diz ao pau: Acorda! e à pedra muda: Desperta! Pode isso ensinar? Eis que está coberta de ouro e de prata, mas dentro dela não há espírito algum.
text_el: οὐαὶ ὁ λέγων τῷ ξύλῳ ἔκνηψον ἐξεγέρθητι καὶ τῷ λίθῳ ὑψώθητι καὶ αὐτό ἐστιν φαντασία τοῦτο δέ ἐστιν ἔλασμα χρυσίου καὶ ἀργυρίου καὶ πᾶν πνεῦμα οὐκ ἔστιν ἐν αὐτῷ

text_en: But the Lord is in his holy temple : let all the earth keep silence before him.
text_la: Dominus autem in templo sancto suo : sileat a facie ejus omnis terra!
text_pt: Mas o Senhor está no seu santo templo; cale-se diante dele toda a terra.
text_el: ὁ δὲ κύριος ἐν ναῷ ἁγίῳ αὐτοῦ εὐλαβείσθω ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ πᾶσα ἡ γῆ

text_en: A prayer of Habacuc the Prophet for ignorances .
text_la: Oratio Habacuc prophetæ, pro ignorantiis.
text_pt: Oração do profeta Habacuque sobre Sigionote.
text_el: προσευχὴ Αμβακουμ τοῦ προφήτου μετὰ ᾠδῆς

text_en: O Lord , I have heard your hearing, and was afraid . O Lord , your work, in the midst of the years bring it to life : In the midst of the years you shall make it known : when you are angry , you will remember mercy.
text_la: Domine, audivi auditionem tuam, et timui. Domine, opus tuum, in medio annorum vivifica illud; in medio annorum notum facies : cum iratus fueris, misericordiæ recordaberis.
text_pt: Ouvi, Senhor, a tua palavra, e temi; aviva, ó Senhor, a tua obra no meio dos anos, no meio dos anos faze-a conhecida; na tua ira lembra-te da misericórdia.
text_el: κύριε εἰσακήκοα τὴν ἀκοήν σου καὶ ἐφοβήθην κατενόησα τὰ ἔργα σου καὶ ἐξέστην ἐν μέσῳ δύο ζῴων γνωσθήσῃ ἐν τῷ ἐγγίζειν τὰ ἔτη ἐπιγνωσθήσῃ ἐν τῷ παρεῖναι τὸν καιρὸν ἀναδειχθήσῃ ἐν τῷ ταραχθῆναι τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐν ὀργῇ ἐλέους μνησθήσῃ

text_en: God will come from the south, and the holy one from mount Pharan: His glory covered the heavens , and the earth is full of his praise.
text_la: Deus ab austro veniet, et Sanctus de monte Pharan : operuit cælos gloria ejus, et laudis ejus plena est terra.
text_pt: Deus veio de Temã, e do monte de Parã o Santo (Selá). A sua glória cobriu os céus, e a terra encheu-se do seu louvor.
text_el: ὁ θεὸς ἐκ Θαιμαν ἥξει καὶ ὁ ἅγιος ἐξ ὄρους κατασκίου δασέος διάψαλμα ἐκάλυψεν οὐρανοὺς ἡ ἀρετὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ αἰνέσεως αὐτοῦ πλήρης ἡ γῆ

text_en: His brightness shall be as the light: horns are in his hands: There is his strength hid:
text_la: Splendor ejus ut lux erit, cornua in manibus ejus : ibi abscondita est fortitudo ejus.
text_pt: E o resplendor se fez como a luz, raios brilhantes saíam da sua mão, e ali estava o esconderijo da sua força.
text_el: καὶ φέγγος αὐτοῦ ὡς φῶς ἔσται κέρατα ἐν χερσὶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔθετο ἀγάπησιν κραταιὰν ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ

text_en: Death shall go before his face. And the devil shall go forth before his feet.
text_la: Ante faciem ejus ibit mors, et egredietur diabolus ante pedes ejus.
text_pt: Adiante dele ia a peste, e brasas ardentes saíam dos seus passos.
text_el: πρὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ πορεύσεται λόγος καὶ ἐξελεύσεται ἐν πεδίλοις οἱ πόδες αὐτοῦ

text_en: He stood and measured the earth. He beheld, and melted the nations : and the ancient mountains were crushed to pieces. The hills of the world were bowed down by the journeys of his eternity .
text_la: Stetit, et mensus est terram; aspexit, et dissolvit gentes, et contriti sunt montes sæculi : incurvati sunt colles mundi ab itineribus æternitatis ejus.
text_pt: Parou, e mediu a terra; olhou, e separou as nações; e os montes perpétuos foram esmiuçados; os outeiros eternos se abateram, porque os caminhos eternos lhe pertencem.
text_el: ἔστη καὶ ἐσαλεύθη ἡ γῆ ἐπέβλεψεν καὶ διετάκη ἔθνη διεθρύβη τὰ ὄρη βίᾳ ἐτάκησαν βουνοὶ αἰώνιοι

text_en: I saw the tents of Ethiopia for their iniquity , the curtains of the land of Madian shall be troubled.
text_la: Pro iniquitate vidi tentoria Æthiopiæ; turbabuntur pelles terræ Madian.
text_pt: Vi as tendas de Cusã em aflição; tremiam as cortinas da terra de Midiã.
text_el: πορείας αἰωνίας αὐτοῦ ἀντὶ κόπων εἶδον σκηνώματα Αἰθιόπων πτοηθήσονται καὶ αἱ σκηναὶ γῆς Μαδιαμ

text_en: Were you angry , O Lord , with the rivers? Or was your wrath upon the rivers? Or your indignation in the sea? Who will ride upon your horses: and your chariots are salvation .
text_la: Numquid in fluminibus iratus es, Domine? aut in fluminibus furor tuus? vel in mari indignatio tua? Qui ascendes super equos tuos, et quadrigæ tuæ salvatio.
text_pt: Acaso é contra os rios, Senhor, que estás irado? É contra os ribeiros a tua ira, ou contra o mar o teu furor, visto que andas montado sobre os teus cavalos, e nos teus carros de salvação?
text_el: μὴ ἐν ποταμοῖς ὠργίσθης κύριε ἢ ἐν ποταμοῖς ὁ θυμός σου ἢ ἐν θαλάσσῃ τὸ ὅρμημά σου ὅτι ἐπιβήσῃ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἵππους σου καὶ ἡ ἱππασία σου σωτηρία

text_en: You will surely take up your bow: according to the oaths which you have spoken to the tribes . You will divide the rivers of the earth.
text_la: Suscitans suscitabis arcum tuum, juramenta tribubus quæ locutus es; fluvios scindes terræ.
text_pt: Descoberto se movimentou o teu arco; os juramentos feitos às tribos foram uma palavra segura. (Selá. ) Tu fendeste a terra com rios.
text_el: ἐντείνων ἐντενεῖς τὸ τόξον σου ἐπὶ τὰ σκῆπτρα λέγει κύριος διάψαλμα ποταμῶν ῥαγήσεται γῆ

text_en: The mountains saw you, and were grieved: the great body of waters passed away. The deep put forth its voice: the deep lifted up its hands.
text_la: Viderunt te, et doluerunt montes; gurges aquarum transiit : dedit abyssus vocem suam; altitudo manus suas levavit.
text_pt: Os montes te viram, e tremeram; a inundação das águas passou; o abismo deu a sua voz, levantou ao alto as suas mãos.
text_el: ὄψονταί σε καὶ ὠδινήσουσιν λαοί σκορπίζων ὕδατα πορείας αὐτοῦ ἔδωκεν ἡ ἄβυσσος φωνὴν αὐτῆς ὕψος φαντασίας αὐτῆς

text_en: The sun and the moon stood still in their habitation, in the light of your arrows, they shall go in the brightness of your glittering spear.
text_la: Sol et luna steterunt in habitaculo suo : in luce sagittarum tuarum ibunt, in splendore fulgurantis hastæ tuæ.
text_pt: O sol e a lua pararam nas suas moradas; andaram à luz das tuas flechas, ao resplendor do relâmpago da tua lança.
text_el: ἐπήρθη ὁ ἥλιος καὶ ἡ σελήνη ἔστη ἐν τῇ τάξει αὐτῆς εἰς φῶς βολίδες σου πορεύσονται εἰς φέγγος ἀστραπῆς ὅπλων σου

text_en: In your anger you will tread the earth under foot: in your wrath you will astonish the nations .
text_la: In fremitu conculcabis terram; in furore obstupefacies gentes.
text_pt: Com indignação marchaste pela terra, com ira trilhaste os gentios.
text_el: ἐν ἀπειλῇ ὀλιγώσεις γῆν καὶ ἐν θυμῷ κατάξεις ἔθνη

text_en: You went forth for the salvation of your people: for salvation with your Christ . You struck the head of the house of the wicked : you have laid bare his foundation even to the neck.
text_la: Egressus es in salutem populi tui, in salutem cum christo tuo : percussisti caput de domo impii, denudasti fundamentum ejus usque ad collum.
text_pt: Tu saíste para salvação do teu povo, para salvação do teu ungido; tu feriste a cabeça da casa do ímpio, descobrindo o alicerce até ao pescoço. (Selá.)
text_el: ἐξῆλθες εἰς σωτηρίαν λαοῦ σου τοῦ σῶσαι τοὺς χριστούς σου ἔβαλες εἰς κεφαλὰς ἀνόμων θάνατον ἐξήγειρας δεσμοὺς ἕως τραχήλου διάψαλμα

text_en: You have cursed his sceptres, the head of his warriors, them that came out as a whirlwind to scatter me. Their joy was like that of him that devours the poor man in secret.
text_la: Maledixisti sceptris ejus, capiti bellatorum ejus, venientibus ut turbo ad dispergendum me : exsultatio eorum, sicut ejus qui devorat pauperem in abscondito.
text_pt: Tu traspassaste com as suas próprias lanças a cabeça das suas vilas; eles me acometeram tempestuosos para me espalharem; alegravam-se, como se estivessem para devorar o pobre em segredo.
text_el: διέκοψας ἐν ἐκστάσει κεφαλὰς δυναστῶν σεισθήσονται ἐν αὐτῇ διανοίξουσιν χαλινοὺς αὐτῶν ὡς ἔσθων πτωχὸς λάθρᾳ

text_en: You made a way in the sea for your horses, in the mud of many waters.
text_la: Viam fecisti in mari equis tuis, in luto aquarum multarum.
text_pt: Tu com os teus cavalos marchaste pelo mar, pela massa de grandes águas.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεβίβασας εἰς θάλασσαν τοὺς ἵππους σου ταράσσοντας ὕδωρ πολύ

text_en: I have heard and my bowels were troubled: my lips trembled at the voice. Let rottenness enter into my bones, and swarm under me. That I may rest in the day of tribulation: that I may go up to our people that are girded.
text_la: Audivi, et conturbatus est venter meus; a voce contremuerunt labia mea. Ingrediatur putredo in ossibus meis, et subter me scateat : ut requiescam in die tribulationis, ut ascendam ad populum accinctum nostrum.
text_pt: Ouvindo-o eu, o meu ventre se comoveu, à sua voz tremeram os meus lábios; entrou a podridão nos meus ossos, e estremeci dentro de mim; no dia da angústia descansarei, quando subir contra o povo que invadirá com suas tropas.
text_el: ἐφυλαξάμην καὶ ἐπτοήθη ἡ κοιλία μου ἀπὸ φωνῆς προσευχῆς χειλέων μου καὶ εἰσῆλθεν τρόμος εἰς τὰ ὀστᾶ μου καὶ ὑποκάτωθέν μου ἐταράχθη ἡ ἕξις μου ἀναπαύσομαι ἐν ἡμέρᾳ θλίψεως τοῦ ἀναβῆναι εἰς λαὸν παροικίας μου

text_en: For the fig tree shall not blossom: and there shall be no spring in the vines. The labour of the olive tree shall fail: and the fields shall yield no food: the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls.
text_la: Ficus enim non florebit, et non erit germen in vineis; mentietur opus olivæ, et arva non afferent cibum : abscindetur de ovili pecus, et non erit armentum in præsepibus.
text_pt: Porque ainda que a figueira não floresça, nem haja fruto na vide; ainda que decepcione o produto da oliveira, e os campos não produzam mantimento; ainda que as ovelhas da malhada sejam arrebatadas, e nos currais não haja gado;
text_el: διότι συκῆ οὐ καρποφορήσει καὶ οὐκ ἔσται γενήματα ἐν ταῖς ἀμπέλοις ψεύσεται ἔργον ἐλαίας καὶ τὰ πεδία οὐ ποιήσει βρῶσιν ἐξέλιπον ἀπὸ βρώσεως πρόβατα καὶ οὐχ ὑπάρχουσιν βόες ἐπὶ φάτναις

text_en: But I will rejoice in the Lord : and I will joy in God my Jesus.
text_la: Ego autem in Domino gaudebo; et exsultabo in Deo Jesu meo.
text_pt: Todavia eu me alegrarei no Senhor; exultarei no Deus da minha salvação.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ἐν τῷ κυρίῳ ἀγαλλιάσομαι χαρήσομαι ἐπὶ τῷ θεῷ τῷ σωτῆρί μου

text_en: The Lord God is my strength: and he will make my feet like the feet of harts: and he the conqueror will lead me upon my high places singing psalms .
text_la: Deus Dominus fortitudo mea, et ponet pedes meos quasi cervorum : et super excelsa mea deducet me victor in psalmis canentem.
text_pt: O Senhor Deus é a minha força, e fará os meus pés como os das cervas, e me fará andar sobre as minhas alturas. (Para o cantor-mor sobre os meus instrumentos de corda).
text_el: κύριος ὁ θεὸς δύναμίς μου καὶ τάξει τοὺς πόδας μου εἰς συντέλειαν ἐπὶ τὰ ὑψηλὰ ἐπιβιβᾷ με τοῦ νικῆσαι ἐν τῇ ᾠδῇ αὐτοῦ
